mapper.select: SELECT bt.* FROM blog_trending bt INNER JOIN ( SELECT post_id, MAX(date) as max_date FROM blog_trending WHERE date >= #{dateStart} AND date < #{dateEnd} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY post_id ) latest ON bt.post_id = latest.post_id AND bt.date = latest.max_date WHERE bt.date >= #{dateStart} AND bt.date < #{dateEnd} AND bt.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY bt.score DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_trending (post_id, score, view_count, like_count, comment_count, date, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{trending.postId}, #{trending.score}, #{trending.viewCount}, #{trending.likeCount}, #{trending.commentCount}, #{trending.statDate}, NOW(), NOW(), 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE score = #{trending.score}, view_count = #{trending.viewCount}, like_count = #{trending.likeCount}, comment_count = #{trending.commentCount}, is_deleted = 0, update_time = NOW()

INSERT OR REPLACE INTO blog_trending (post_id, score, view_count, like_count, comment_count, date, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{trending.postId}, #{trending.score}, #{trending.viewCount}, #{trending.likeCount}, #{trending.commentCount}, #{trending.statDate}, datetime('now','localtime'), datetime('now','localtime'))

MERGE INTO blog_trending (post_id, score, view_count, like_count, comment_count, date, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) KEY(post_id, date) VALUES (#{trending.postId}, #{trending.score}, #{trending.viewCount}, #{trending.likeCount}, #{trending.commentCount}, #{trending.statDate}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0)
